goal: Reduce future ImGui upgrade impact by isolating ImGui context, IO hook ownership, platform viewport handling, draw-data recording, and presentation routing behind one render-owned integration boundary.

document_contract.checkpoint_density_rule: This milestone completes in two large checkpoints. Do not split into stage files unless the implementation discovers a hard dependency.
document_contract.update_rule: Replans must update this milestone file and the active checkpoint file in the same change.
document_contract.validation_rule: Use only existing repository scripts. Primary gates are just b for build and just r only when runtime behavior is touched.

fixed_decisions.decision: Engine input is derived from a concrete ImGuiIO wrapper/snapshot after ImGui consumes native events.
fixed_decisions.implementation_impact: Delete GLFW callback-side input writes and replace them with one ImGuiIOInput-to-engine-input update path.

fixed_decisions.decision: Keep official imgui_impl_glfw as the platform backend.
fixed_decisions.implementation_impact: Centralize official backend calls instead of implementing a custom ImGui platform backend.

fixed_decisions.decision: Keep extra ImGui viewport presentation as independent RHI submits initially.
fixed_decisions.implementation_impact: Do not batch platform viewport presents in this milestone unless a concrete ordering bug blocks correctness.

target_contracts.name: WindowSystem
owns: Native handle and surface creation data

target_contracts.name: ImGuiIntegration
owns: Font atlas upload and image registration
must_not_own: Window creation policy beyond official backend callbacks

target_contracts.name: ImGuiIOInput
owns: One per-frame input snapshot derived from ImGuiIO
Mouse, wheel, key, capture, and cursor policy inputs

architecture_rules.rule: Only ImGuiIntegration may call imgui_impl_glfw APIs.
No GLFW callback writes WindowInput camera, mouse, key, scroll, or play-mode state.
Renderer and editor code must not depend on raw ImGuiViewport for swapchain or framebuffer ownership.
RHI swapchain creation must not call WindowContext.
Main-window present and platform-window present use the same PresentationSurface contract, while platform-window present remains independently submitted in this milestone.
Delete obsolete callback and UI renderer surfaces instead of preserving compatibility shims.

checkpoints.title: ImGui IO ownership and engine input reroute
exit_gate: ImGuiIntegration is the only native IO hook owner.
ImGuiIOInput is the only source for editor camera/play input.
GLFW callback-side WindowInput writes are deleted.
Official imgui_impl_glfw remains the platform backend.

checkpoints.title: Presentation boundary and ImGui renderer upgrade surface
exit_gate: PresentationSurface owns main and platform viewport swapchains.
VulkanSwapChain no longer depends on WindowContext.
Editor/renderer code does not expose raw ImGuiViewport framebuffer ownership.
Public UI integration surface is reduced to one render-owned path.

current_implementation: ImGUIRenderBackend initializes imgui_impl_glfw with callback installation enabled.
Current behavior depends on callback chaining and ordering.
implementation_gap_assessment.target_contract: Only ImGuiIntegration owns native IO hook installation.
required_delta: Remove GLFW callback-side engine input writes.
implementation_gap_assessment.risk: High. Input behavior changes are user-visible and affect camera, UI text input, F5/F8 play mode, and cursor capture.

current_implementation: WindowInput is mutated in GLFW callbacks.
EditorUI also mutates WindowInput from ImGui window state.
No single frame input snapshot exists.
implementation_gap_assessment.target_contract: Editor and play input are derived from one ImGuiIOInput snapshot after ImGui frame input is valid.
required_delta: Move camera/play/cursor policy to consume the snapshot once per frame.
Keep WindowInput only as a temporary engine-facing state sink.
implementation_gap_assessment.risk: High. Bad ordering will break camera focus or UI capture.

current_implementation: Renderer constructs main SwapchainCreateInfo from WindowContext::GetMainWindow.
VulkanSwapChain includes WindowContext and calls WindowContext::CreateVulkanSurface.
ImGUIRenderer platform viewport callbacks create and resize swapchains directly.
implementation_gap_assessment.target_contract: PresentationSurface owns swapchain lifecycle and supplies backend-neutral surface creation data to RHI.
required_delta: Route ImGui platform viewport swapchains through PresentationSurface.
implementation_gap_assessment.risk: Critical. Resize, minimize, shutdown, and detached viewport present can deadlock or present wrong textures if ordering is wrong.

current_implementation: EditorUI queries ImGui::FindWindowByName and asks UIRenderer for viewport framebuffer.
UiCombinePass can draw scene output into an ImGui platform viewport framebuffer.
RenderGUI updates platform windows after main draw recording.
implementation_gap_assessment.target_contract: Raw ImGuiViewport mapping is private to ImGuiIntegration; editor and renderer use typed render target contracts.
required_delta: Replace public GetWindowFrameBuffer(raw viewport) with a typed Scene Color target request.
Ensure detached Scene Color never overrides main-window present source.
Move platform viewport resource availability checks into ImGuiIntegration/PresentationSurface.
implementation_gap_assessment.risk: High. This is the same ownership class as the detached Scene Color present bug.

current_implementation: There is a legacy global non-namespaced UIRenderer path and a Moer::Render::UIRenderer path.
Profiler has a separate manual window/swapchain/UI render loop.
ImGUIRenderer owns too many concerns in one file.
implementation_gap_assessment.target_contract: One render-owned UI integration surface contains ImGui version-sensitive code and exposes only lifecycle, input snapshot, image registration, draw recording, viewport update, and present.
required_delta: Align profiler and editor on the same UI lifecycle where practical.
Keep ImGui version-sensitive code inside the smallest possible integration module.
implementation_gap_assessment.risk: Medium. Mostly API cleanup, but profiler/editor lifecycle drift can reintroduce upgrade friction.

validation: For planning-only changes, no runtime validation is required.
For CP-01 implementation, run just b and just r; manually cover camera, text input, F5/F8, cursor capture, and Scene Color hover focus.
For CP-02 implementation, run just b and just r; manually cover main resize, detach, detached resize, minimize/restore, re-dock, renderer switch, profiler startup if available, and shutdown.
Do not add new validation scripts.
